tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshangs pa zhi drag gi gsol mchod dge/ na mo gu ru badz+ra pa ṇi dharmā rā dza pad+mā ka ra ma hā brāh+ma ṇi bh+yaḥ gdod nas ma g.yos rig rtsal du/ /bla ma yi dam bstan srung sogs/ /sna tshogs sgyu mar gus btud de/ /sgyu ma'i mchod bskang bstod sogs spel/ /zhes smros te sa lugs ltar na 'khor 'das dbyer med dregs pa'i ded dpon tshangs pa dung thod can zhes zhi ba dang / btsan rgod bse khrab can zhes drag por 'char ba 'di dag la tshangs pa zhi drag gi mtshan thogs zhig 'dug pas bka' gter dag snang brgyud ldan bla ma'i khungs shig cis kyang yod 'gro yang rang nyid mthong thos chung zhing dpal sa skya'i bka' srol la lugs 'di ha cang zhib pa zhig kyang mi 'dug pa'i bag chags kyis khungs chod rang ni zhu ma shes/ 'on kyang chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i gser khri srid zhi'i rgyan gcig la rgyal ba mi'i rnam rol du shar ba paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i zhal sgo las byon pa'i 'di pa'i mchod phrin rje drung rin po che bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bskang mdos sogs rgya cher bzhugs pa'i dgongs don mkha' lding dbang po'i gshog rlabs bye'us rjes snyegs lta bus 'bri na/ sbyor ba tshangs pa zhi drag sku bris 'bur gang rung bzhugs par gnam sa bar gyi mdzes rgyan spyan gzigs srung ma spyi 'gre ltar gyis brgyan pa'i gzhir gtor stegs khebs bzang 'bru snas khyab khar gser dngul zangs li 'khar sder la sogs nas/ tha na rdzas dang rdo leb gtsang ma lta bu'i khar nas 'bras sogs 'bru rjen btags kyi tsam pa/ chang / khrag mar/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ chos sman gang rung 'dres pa bcas las tshangs par gsang phyi zhes pa gtor ma zlum nar rtse smyung gi rtse'i 'og tsam nas g.yas g.yon du nya gshog 'dra mo dang / de'i 'og tsam du'ang de 'dra bcas gshog pa bzhi yod pa/ de'i phyed tsam nub pa'i mtheb kyu bcad khams phyir bstan gyis bskor bar rgyun du brgya rtsa/

rgyas las bsgrubs na brgya rtsa brgyad/ dbang la lnga bcu/ drag po la drug cu rtsa bzhi'i grangs mar rgyan dkyil du lnga/ rtser sgor mo rtse bsangs de dag kyang dmar mdangs spel zhing bu ram dang sha dmar sgril bas brgyan pa mda' dar dkar po can/ drag po bse khrab la gtor rgyu gong bzhin la btsan gtor gru gsum zur rtse rno ba'i ldebs sgrub pa por bstan cing mtheb skyus grangs rgyan sogs gong bzhin mda' dar dmar po gtor ma gnyis ka'ang smug rtsi can gyi drung chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga sman raka bcas bsdus pa'i lugs dang / rgyas par spro na/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i bskang mdos kyi gzhung ltar bsham zhing rnga rol sogs 'du bya'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ yi dam chos srung gzhan dang lhan cig yin na bdag bskyed zur du mi dgos/ 'dir rkyang pa'i lugs ltar zhu na/ bdag bskyed ni/ ngag tu/ bla ma yi dam rtsa gsum mchog gsum la/ /bdag dang 'gro rnams byang chub bar skyabs mchi/ /sems can don du yi dam lhag pa'i lhas/ /bsgom bzlas lam rim zab mor 'jug par bya/ /zhes lan gsum sogs/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng / /rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ mtshan las/ /'od 'phros don gnyis byas shing 'dus/ /yongs gyur rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag /mthing nag khro bo rngam pa'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /phyag g.yas gser rdor rtse lnga 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /dar sngon stod g.yogs stag sham can/ /sbrul rgyan g.yas g.yon zhabs kyi stabs/ /g.yon brkyang me 'bar dbus bzhugs kyi/ /dpral mgrin thugs kar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs nas/ /dam tshig par thim dbang gi lhas/ /dbang bskur mi bskyod dbu rgyan can/ /thugs kar nyi dkyil hūm̐ gi mthar/ /sngags bskor de yi 'od zer gyis/ /grub gnyis lhun gyis stsol bar gyur/

/oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ ci nus mthar/ bdag dang sems can nad gnod zhi/ /bsam don lhun grub gsang bdag gi /go 'phang thob nas de yi sar/ /'khrul snang dbyings su dag par shog /de nas rnga rol sogs sgrags la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥmachod gtor rnams/ /rab sbyangs snod bcud mthun rdzas kyi/ /rang mdangs kha dog dri ro dang / /nus ldan bstan srung dgyes skong gyur/ /hūm̐ rang nyid gsang bdag dpa' bo'i mdun/ /pad nyir tri las tshangs pa che/ /dkar mdangs 'dzum rgyas chags khro'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /phyag g.yas zangs gri dar rgyan can/ /phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub rlung zhags sngo/ /mchan na ne'u le'i rkyal pa dang / /ru mtshon dkar sgreng za 'og gos/ /dkar dmar ljang ber rin chen rgyan/ /thor nag dar dmar dung thod can/ /nor bu'i l+h+wam can zhabs gnyis pa/ /rta mchog ngang dkar sga chas kun/ /chibs shing sprul pa yang sprul sogs/ /bsam yas dbus na gar dgu'i nyams/ /de g.yon khro bo'i rol par ni/ /btsan rgod rgyal chen bse khrab can/ /khrag mdog ya sos ma mchu mnan/ /spyan gsum bgrad cing khro gnyer can/ /sma ra smin rtsub 'bar 'jigs phyag g.yas g.yon bing 'phyar btsan zhags 'phen/ /bse yi khrab rmog rta rag la/ /sga chas rdzogs chibs 'khor dang bcas/ /de lta'i zhi drag rnam rol ni/ /mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ /hūm̐ zhi ba'i tshul 'chang tshangs pa dung gi mtshan/ /drag po'i rnam rol rgyal chen bse khrab can/ /'dir gshegs dgyes bzhugs mchod gtor mthun rdzas bzhes/ /bka' dam bzhin du bdag gi las mdzod cig /hūm̐ phyi yi mchod rdzas srid gsum dpal 'byor tshangs/ /nang ltar dam can dgyes pa'i yo byad spras/ /gsang ba bde stong rol gar 'dis bskang ngo / /rgyal po sras yum blon 'bangs dgyes dgur rol/ /hūm̐ rgyu bzhi'i bcas rang sdig ltung spyi bye brag /stobs bzhis bshags sdom dam can ma dgyes kun/

/las bzhi'i dbyings bshags bdag 'gro'i 'phral yun don/ /rnam bzhi'i las mdzod zhi drag tshangs pa che/ /hūm̐ gsang ba'i bdag po chos rgyal srong btsan rje/ /gu ru pad+ma dam ldan mkhas grub drung / /zhal bzhes thugs dam dus las mi g.yel bar/ /bstan 'gro'i don las ma g.yel sa mā ya/ /hūm̐ rnam dag pho brang zhing rngams gzhal yas su/ /rnam dag zhi rgyas chags nyams tshangs pa che/ /rnam dag gtum pa'i nyams 'bar bse khrab can/ /rnam dag yon tan kun la bdag bstod do/ /hūm̐ thun mong srid zhi'i dge mtshan dri bzhon lam/ /mchog gi dngos grub chu 'dzin sna tshogs klong / /dgos 'dod zim char 'khor 'das kun dga'i dpyid/ /nam yang 'gag med bstan srung mnga' gsol lo/ /hūm̐ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das lam kun la/ sngon las 'phral rkyen mi mthun rgud pa'i tshogs/ /yid srubs glags lta'i sbyor ba ji snyed kun/ /rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings su bzlog par mdzod/ /hūm̐ srid zhi'i dgos pa kun tshang snod bcud la/ /rgyal bas byin phob 'jig rten bde zhing skyid/ /bshad sgrub smin grol bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho cher/ /rnam grol yid bzhin nor gyis phyug par mdzod/ /hūm̐ dngos 'byor yid sprul lha chen mchod pa'i rdzas/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas bsngos 'di legs bzhes la/ /bdag gis ji ltar bskang bshags bstod phrin gyis/ /re smon mchog stsol bkra shis deng 'dir byon/ /zhes gtor ma sman raka mchod rdzas bcas nub re bzhin khra 'brug sogs tshangs pa bzhugs phyogs su phul la/ hūm̐ mdun gyi dam ye dbyer med brtan bzhugs bsam/ /ye shes pa gshegs dam rten rang la thim/ /gnas gsum rgyas btab dge ba rdzogs byang bsngo/ /phyogs dus kun tu dge zhing shis gyur cig /ces 'di rnam 'dren rgyal dbang mchog /'jam mtshan bka' spyir legs nos pa/ /sa skya kun blos gzhung sngon dgongs/ /bsdus tshangs gsan bde'i mchod rdzas bskrun/

/rgyas par mkhas grub gsung rab las/ /mkhyen par mdzod cig 'jig rten dbang / /nyes kun bshags so legs kun gyis/ /dam pa'i dgongs bzang bzhin 'grub nas/ /mkhyen brtse nus byin stsal du gsol// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ tshangs pa zhi drag gi gsol mchod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
